verdict.rationale: Merchants get an allow/deny-style gate via per-agent onboarding consent ("review its terms", agent must accept an approval request) and can terminate an Order Coordination Agreement at any time, plus SPT usage caps (currency/max amount/expiration) limit financial exposure per transaction. However, there is no documented per-agent or per-platform rate-limiting control on catalog/checkout access, only account-level onboarding approval and financial ceilings. Missing for 10: explicit rate-limiting mechanisms for specific agents/platforms, and finer-grained catalog-visibility allow/deny beyond initial onboarding consent.
